roles.headline: Reading the Night So Investors Don't Have To
roles.lede: Hivemind's Iris is a portfolio-intelligence product for individual investors. It reads filings, news, and the supply-chain map behind a person's holdings overnight and surfaces the few things that actually reach their portfolio.
details: LLM-powered research pipelines (retrieval-augmented generation with traceable, source-cited outputs) and the knowledge graph mapping relationships between companies: supply chains, ownership, policy, earnings, and macro events.
roles.scale: 11,000+ companies, 27,000+ links; 96+ sources and 1.2M+ data points per day feeding daily briefs.

roles.headline: Teaching a Laptop to Notice a Fall

bullets.name: Hermathena
bullets.text: an AI-powered IT service management platform. A natural-language, LLM-driven intake assistant replaces static ticket forms, then requests flow through classification, SLA tracking, and closure on an append-only, event-sourced Python/FastAPI + PostgreSQL backend. Role-based React + TypeScript (Vite) app with server-enforced permissions across four roles.

bullets.name: Behavior engine
bullets.text: a privacy-first, real-time human-behavior recognition engine running at 18.6 FPS on a laptop CPU (no GPU). Skeleton-based: fall detection via an ST-GCN (F1 0.78 on the URFD dataset), plus rule-based person-down and loitering detection on one shared backbone; exported to ONNX with 100% prediction agreement.

roles.headline: A Second Opinion for High-Risk Pregnancies
details: A full-stack clinical dashboard built for a project with the Indian Council of Medical Research, helping Medical Officers manage high-risk pregnancies. It uses a typed, reusable clinical rules engine with risk explainability and role-based access, plus guideline-based workflows across risk assessment, diagnosis, treatment planning, monitoring, and referral.

roles.funding: on a project funded by DRDO's Aeronautics Research & Development Board
roles.headline: Reading Motion, One Skeleton at a Time
details: Built real-time person detection and tracking with YOLOv11 and a skeleton-based action-recognition module (Temporal Convolutional Network trained on NTU RGB+D 3D-skeleton data: 10K+ sequences, 24 action classes, NVIDIA Tesla T4 GPUs), then integrated the two into an end-to-end activity-recognition system.

roles.headline: Three Million Songs a Week, Fifty Milliseconds Each
details: Backend services for a distributed Discord music platform serving 200K+ monthly active users and 3M+ weekly audio streams. RESTful microservices in Node.js (Express) on Docker/Kubernetes with service discovery; a WebSocket sharding system with caching and load balancing for sub-50 ms real-time latency.
